# iso20022-parser

> Parse and validate ISO 20022 pacs.008 and camt.053 messages with hardened XML parsing, XSD validation and typed extraction of payment and statement fields Maven artifact `io.github.trysac:iso20022-parser`, Java package
> `io.github.trysac.iso20022_parser`, MIT licensed, Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
